definitions.full: H1267. baruth [ בָּרוּת ] noun feminine food ; בְּבָרוּתִי Psa 69:22 in (or as ) my food . II. ברה (compare Assyrian barû , bind , whence birîtu , fetter Zim BP 59, 82, & treaty, covenant Dl K 7 ).
